name: communication
summary: Agents write in your voice, give short updates, and share plans and previews as links.
day: Agents draft messages, pull request descriptions, and docs the way you write them. Plans and running apps reach other people as links.
cost: No extra usage beyond the drafts you ask for.

workflows.name: Your voice
workflows.sentence: Agents write messages, pull request descriptions, and docs in your voice, from a skill you own.

moment.title: A draft that sounds like you
moment.body: You ask for a reply to a long thread. The agent drafts it in your voice, with the point first, and you send it with one edit.

workflows.name: Updates and shared plans
workflows.sentence: Agents give updates with the outcome first, and share plans and reports as one link.

moment.title: One link for the team
moment.body: You ask for the plan as a page. The agent publishes it to a private link that you paste into the team channel.

workflows.name: Previews
workflows.sentence: A running app or UI change on your devbox opens as a private link on any of your devices.

moment.title: Try it on your phone
moment.body: The agent finishes a UI change on the devbox and sends you a private preview link. You open it on your phone before you read the diff.
